hook.label: తెలుగుదనం · Telugudanam
hook.say: What makes Telugu, Telugu? The online museum Telugudanam answers in five modules. Here is what each one finds.

beats.label: Script · 1
beats.say: The script came from Ashoka's Brahmi. In the south it loosened and looped, at Bhattiprolu, then in a shared Telugu and Kannada script, until Telugu had its own by the eleventh century.

beats.label: Script · 2
beats.say: Why is Telugu so round? It was written on palm leaves with an iron stylus. A straight line across the leaf's veins would split it, so every stroke learned to curve.

beats.label: Script · 3
beats.big: A script that crossed the sea
beats.say: Its ancestor, the Pallava script, sailed to Southeast Asia. Old Khmer, Javanese, Thai and Lao all descend from that same southern hand.

beats.label: Language · 1
beats.say: Telugu is not a daughter of Sanskrit. It is Dravidian, from a family spoken before {3000|three thousand} {BCE|B C E}, and its closest relative is Tulu.

beats.label: Language · 2
beats.say: Telugu stacks suffixes on an unchanging root. Chey, inch, ledu: one word that means, did not cause to do.

beats.label: Language · 3
beats.say: And the world borrowed Telugu. Catamaran comes from kattumaram, and bandicoot from pandikokku.

beats.label: Literature · 1
beats.say: Telugu literature began in the mouth: Burra Katha troupes, Oggu Katha singers, and Vemana's four-line verses against caste and greed.

items: two narrators, a drummer, a commentator
four-line verses against caste and greed

beats.label: Literature · 2
beats.say: Written literature began as translation, in {1022|ten twenty-two}. Three poets across three centuries, Nannayya, Tikkana and Errapragada, wrote one Telugu Mahabharata.

beats.label: Literature · 3
beats.say: Then came spoken-language prose. Gurajada's Kanyasulkam in {1892|eighteen ninety-two}, and Sri Sri's free verse in {1950|nineteen fifty}, brought the street into literature.

scene.en: A country is not its soil, but its people.

beats.label: Diaspora · 1
beats.say: Telugus have been leaving for a thousand years: merchants to Southeast Asia, indentured labourers to four continents, then the Gulf oil boom and the American I T wave.

beats.label: Diaspora · 2
beats.say: In {1970|nineteen seventy} there were about {1,500|fifteen hundred} Telugus in America. By {2024|twenty twenty-four}, over {1.2 million|one point two million}.

scene.unit: Telugu speakers, as stated on the site

beats.label: Diaspora · 3
beats.say: The test is the second generation. In one national survey, only {16|sixteen} percent of immigrant youth spoke their parents' language fluently.

scene.foot: ManaBadi weekend schools: 100,000+ students in 15 countries since 2007

beats.label: Digital · 1
beats.say: Online, Telugu began as broken fonts. Then came eenadu dot net in {1998|nineteen ninety-eight}, the Telugu Wikipedia in {2003|two thousand three}, and Unicode in {2004|two thousand four}.

beats.label: Digital · 2
beats.say: Today Telugu is often typed in the Latin alphabet, mixed with English. Chala bagundi. That is Tenglish, a living new register.

beats.label: Digital · 3
beats.say: And open source keeps Telugu tools in the community's hands: free fonts, open models, and Swecha's Gonthuka speech model.

outro: That is only a glimpse. Visit Telugudanam, and try every exhibit yourself.
